notes.title: Enabled multi-capture
notes.notes: Fixed so that you can capture multiple units in Tafl-games.

notes.title: Ludus
notes.notes: Added the game Ludus latrunculorum. I am aware that multi-capture don't work. Hopefully, that will be fixed in the future.

notes.title: Multiplayer
notes.notes: Now it should be possible to play games with others in your Steam friendslist without the need of sharing the same LAN connection. Now it should be possible to establish direct peer-2-peer connections via the Steam SDK.

notes.title: Xiangqi
notes.notes:
New game variant added: Xiangqi
Try out the most popular board game in the world (played by most number of players).

notes.title: Sound FX
notes.notes: Added sound on/off button and sound effects.

notes.title: Viking Chess
notes.notes:
Added a new game type known as "Viking Chess" or "Hnefatafl".

Hnefatafl was a popular game in medieval Scandinavia and was mentioned in several of the Norse sagas.

notes.title: Chess
notes.notes:
Added chess
AI is worse but the plan is to make it better for all games in the future.
